title: W Social, public institutions and the theater of European digital sovereignty
summary: A critical analysis examining European digital sovereignty initiatives, exploring the relationship between public institutions and social media platforms in the context of data governance and technological independence. The article likely discusses the gap between policy rhetoric and practical implementation of digital sovereignty measures.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of European independence from US-based tech giants and the role of public institutions in establishing digital sovereignty.
why_valuable: Provides critical perspective on the disconnect between political discourse and actual implementation of European digital sovereignty strategies.
